summary.policy: Nominal circular swept footprints, Q16; original allowed-area access Q64. Raw residual retained. Core is residual eroded by the declared chord/rounding tolerance; it is not a general numerical error bound. Diagnostic copper bounding boxes are not physical PCB outlines or CNC validation.
